theater: 青海道積石山至伏俾城

battle.name: 唐擊吐谷渾之戰
battle.theater: 青海道積石山至伏俟城
battle.brief: 貞觀八年夏，吐谷渾可汗慕容伏允寇涼州、鄯州，唐遣交河道行軍總管侯君集率兵討之；貞觀九年太宗親征，分積石、涇河、湟河三道出師，六月大破吐谷渾於烏海、牛心堆，伏允走磧中為部下所殺，太子慕容順降，立西海郡。卡面的羅馬標槍屬羅軍團制式投射兵器，與本役相隔七百年，不在青海戰場。

kit.name: 羅馬標槍
kit.history: 半米長的投槍，槍幹中空。捅穿盾之後就折斷，敵人只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。

countries: 這場戰爭是唐太宗貞觀八年至九年間對青海吐谷渾的兩次軍事行動，戰線在河西走廊西段與青海湖、柴達木盆地一帶。貞觀八年（634）夏，吐谷渾可汗慕容伏允寇犯涼州、鄯州邊境，詔以兵部尚書侯君集為交河道行軍總管，率關中、隴右兵與蕃騎討之，軍循河西走廊西出積石山而入青海；貞觀九年（635）太宗再發大軍，以侯君集為兵道行軍總管、段志玄為積石道行軍總管、李道宗為涇河道行軍總管、李大亮為湟河道行軍總管，並以李靖為西海道行軍大總管，兵分四道直指王城伏俟城。唐軍主力自長安出隴右，糧秣自涼州、鄯州向前轉運，徵發戰馬與輜重車，後勤線延綿數千里，抵青海時已深入高原縱深。吐谷渾一方是慕容氏鮮卑支系建立的游牧政權，以部落分帳為軍，控弦之士精於騎射，兵以輕騎與弓箭為主，輔以長矛、彎刀、馬槊與皮甲，攻城器械極少，王城伏俟城與諸鄣堡皆土築木柵，憑騎兵游擊與地勢消耗敵軍。第三方並未直接用兵：西域諸國遣使觀望，吐蕃此時正處松贊干布君臨初期、尚未與唐正面衝突，但吐谷渾所扼的正是通往蕃地與西域的孔道，故為各方所注目。
countriesEn: This war comprised two Tang military campaigns against Tuyuhun in the Qinghai region, fought between the eighth and ninth years of the Zhenguan era of Emperor Taizong, with the front running through the western end of the Hexi Corridor to Lake Qinghai and the Qaidam basin. In the summer of 634 the Tuyuhun khan Murong Fuyun raided the frontier of Liangzhou and Shanzhou; the court appointed the Minister of War Hou Junji as commander of the campaign on the Jiao River route, and he led troops from Guanzhong and Longyou together with tribal cavalry, moving west along the Hexi Corridor past Mount Jishi into Qinghai. In 635 Taizong raised a large army again: Hou Junji as commander of the Bing route, Duan Zhixuan of the Jishi route, Li Daozong of the Jing River route and Li Daliang of the Huang River route, with Li Jing as grand commander of the Xihai route, so that the army moved in four columns toward the Tuyuhun royal city of Fuhou. The main body left Chang'an through Longyou, with grain and supplies dragged forward from Liangzhou and Shanzhou and war horses and baggage wagons requisitioned; the supply line stretched for thousands of li, and by the time it reached Qinghai the army was deep inside the plateau. Tuyuhun itself was a nomadic polity founded by the Xianbei Murong clan, organised by tribal encampments; its archers were skilled horsemen and archers, its troops light cavalry and bowmen supported by long spears, sabres, horse lances and leather armour, and it possessed almost no siege equipment, its royal city of Fuhou and its frontier forts being earth walls faced with timber. Third powers did not fight here directly: the states of the Western Regions sent envoys to watch, while Tibet under Songtsen Gampo was still early in its reign and had not yet clashed with Tang, though the corridor that Tuyuhun held was precisely the road to Tibet and to the Western Regions, which is why every party kept an eye on it.
people: 唐太宗李世民是此役的策動者與最高統帥。貞觀八年他先遣侯君集出交河道討吐谷渾，軍至積石山以西而糧道告急，諸將議還，他以詔書趣之，追擊至烏海一帶方罷兵；其後仍不甘心，貞觀九年再議大舉，頂著群臣勸阻率軍親征，五月出師，六月戰於烏海、牛心堆、庫山一線，七月班師。兵部尚書侯君集是兩役主將，貞觀八年任交河道行軍總管，貞觀九年復任兵道行軍總管，率騎追擊伏允入磧。西海道行軍大總管李靖以五千精騎夜襲吐谷渾大營，直抵伏俟城下，吐谷渾遣使請降，李靖納之，軍因之而略定其地。段志玄任積石道行軍總管，破吐谷渾於積石山，追奔至烏海；李道宗任涇河道行軍總管，拔牛心堆城，驅追數百里；李大亮任湟河道行軍總管，於赤水源遇吐谷渾萬餘騎而大破之。吐谷渾可汗慕容伏允不肯降，終在逃入大磧後為自己部下所殺；太子慕容順與慕容善先後率眾來降，順被封為西平郡王，其後更立西海郡，以順為太守。
peopleEn: Emperor Taizong Li Shimin was the initiator and supreme commander of the campaign. In 634 he first sent Hou Junji down the Jiao River route against Tuyuhun; when the army reached beyond Mount Jishi and the supply line grew short, the generals proposed to withdraw, but he sent an edict urging them on, and the pursuit continued as far as the neighbourhood of Wuhai before the troops were called back. Uncontent with that, he planned a grand campaign in 635 and, despite remonstrations from the court, led the army himself: the host set out in the fifth month, fought along the line of Wuhai, Niuxindui and Kushan in the sixth, and returned in the seventh. Hou Junji, Minister of War, was the commander of both expeditions, first as commander of the Jiao River route in 634 and then as commander of the Bing route in 635, leading cavalry in the pursuit of Fuyun into the sandy wastes. Li Jing, grand commander of the Xihai route, rode with five thousand picked cavalry in a night attack on the Tuyuhun great camp and reached the foot of Fuhou city, whereupon Tuyuhun sent envoys to surrender; Li Jing accepted them, and the army in consequence took the region with little further fighting. Duan Zhixuan, commander of the Jishi route, broke Tuyuhun at Mount Jishi and pursued them to Wuhai; Li Daozong, commander of the Jing River route, took Niuxindui and drove the enemy for several hundred li; Li Daliang, commander of the Huang River route, met more than ten thousand Tuyuhun horsemen at Chishuiyuan and routed them. The Tuyuhun khan Murong Fuyun would not surrender and was finally killed by his own subordinates after fleeing into the great sand sea; the heir Murong Shun and Murong Shan came in with their followers, Shun was made Prince of Xiping, and later the court established Xihai Commandery with Shun as its governor.
kits: 卡面兵器是羅馬標槍，屬共和末期至帝國時期羅馬軍團的制式投射兵器：半米長的投槍，槍幹中空，矛頭加配重，前段做得薄而輕，捅穿盾面之後即折斷，敵兵只能帶著半截槍退回掩體。標槍的戰術目的不在刺穿人體，而在以密集齊射壓制敵陣、割開前線，逼守軍放棄已占據的位置。到本役的六三四年，羅馬帝國僅存東部，其軍隊仍靠paramirion長矛與skouton短投槍維持這類投射手段，六世紀的戰術手冊仍列有相關條目。青海戰場上不會有這件兵器，唐代文獻從未提及羅馬標槍，中原與吐谷渾的投射武器是弓、臂弩、床弩所發的羽箭，穿甲箭用於射穿皮甲與鎖子甲，近戰則靠長矛、馬槊、陌刀與環首唐刀。唐軍披明光鎧、山字鎠與兜鍪，騎兵用高頭大馬並備馬甲，步卒結陣以橦木為盾，鼓角與旌旗用於傳令和鼓舞。吐谷渾以皮甲、護臂與弓箭為主，彎刀長於騎射時的一擊，馬匹是這一方的核心資產。攻城器械唐軍備而不用，輜重靠牛車與駝隊，糧秣自涼州、鄯州分批北運，雪夜行軍與高原草場的好壞直接決定戰馬的體力。
kitsEn: The weapon on the card is the Roman pilum, the standard missile of the Roman legion from the late Republic and the imperial period: a half-metre javelin with a hollow shaft, a weighted head, and a thin, light front section that snapped after punching through a shield, so that the enemy could only drag himself back behind cover with half a shaft still in his hands. The tactical purpose of the pilum was not to pierce a body but to overwhelm a formation with massed volleys, cut a gap in the front line and force the defenders to give up ground they had occupied. By the year 634 the Roman Empire survived only in the East, and its armies still sustained such missile work through the paramirion and the skouton, both of which still appear in sixth-century tactical manuals. No such weapon would appear on a Qinghai battlefield: Tang texts never mention a Roman pilum, and the missile weapons of both the Chinese and the Tuyuhun were arrows shot from bows, arm crossbows and bed crossbows, with armour-piercing shafts used against leather and mail; at close quarters they relied on long spears, horse lances, the modao blade and the ring-pommel Tang sabre. Tang troops wore Mingguang armour, mountain-pattern lamellar cuirasses and helmets; the cavalry rode tall horses and had barding; infantry formed up behind wooden shields, while drums, horns and banners carried orders and kept up the line of march. Tuyuhun fought with leather armour, arm guards and bows, their sabres made for a single cut while riding at speed, and horses were the core asset on that side. Tang siege gear was prepared but never used, and baggage was moved by ox carts and camel trains; grain came forward from Liangzhou and Shanzhou in stages, and the condition of the grazing on the plateau, in snow and at night, decided how long the horses could hold out.
tactics: 此役的戰術骨架是分道出擊加高速追擊。唐軍不把大軍集中在單一路線，而是以積石道、兵道、涇河道、湟河道分為數路：段志玄出積石山、侯君集趨烏海、李道宗取牛心堆、李大亮自湟河側擊，太宗自率中軍在靈州一線策應，務求切斷王城與各部落的聯繫，再以局部會師完成包圍。作戰重心是突擊而非攻城：唐軍多以輕兵銳進、夜襲其營，繞開城寨而直取草場、牧群與移動中的部落，李靖率五千精騎即為典型；兵鋒所及之處，吐谷渾的帳幕與積存被焚，部眾散入草場。追擊階段最見分曉，伏允自烏海逃入柴達木方向的大磧後，唐軍入磧，缺水缺草，戰馬大量掉膘、士卒多病，追擊在極限處收斂，最終不是被唐軍擒獲，而是被其部下所殺。吐谷渾的對策以游騎與遲滯為主：前哨退入草場，燃燒草料與帳幕、掩埋物資、驅散馬群，游騎襲擾唐軍糧道，利用高原距離遲滯唐軍推進；其精騎多在唐軍列陣未成時以箭矢襲擾，隨即拉開，避免被弩箭與突騎捲入。收編階段以郡縣與屯田落地，設西海郡、鄯州、廓州，置官編戶，使吐谷渾諸部由部落編制轉入唐的羈縻體系。
tacticsEn: The tactical skeleton of this war was a combination of attacks along separate columns with high-speed pursuit. Tang did not concentrate its host on a single line but divided it into the Jishi, Bing, Jing River and Huang River routes: Duan Zhixuan took Mount Jishi, Hou Junji moved towards Wuhai, Li Daozong struck at Niuxindui and Li Daliang came in from the side by the Huang River, while Taizong himself led the central force on the Lingzhou line, the object being to cut the royal city off from the various tribes and then to close the net by local convergence. The centre of gravity was the surprise attack rather than the siege: Tang columns advanced light, struck camps at night, bypassed the fortified places and went instead for the pastures, the herds and the moving tribal groups, Li Jing's five thousand picked cavalry being the textbook case; where the blow landed, tents and stores were burned and the people scattered into the grass. The pursuit phase shows the limits of the operation most clearly. After Fuyun fled from Wuhai into the great sand sea of the Qaidam, the Tang army followed him in, where there was neither water nor fodder, the horses lost their strength in large numbers and the men fell sick, and the pursuit closed at its extreme limit: Fuyun was not taken by Tang troops but killed by his own men. Tuyuhun's answer was harassment and delay: outposts withdrew into the grass, burning fodder and tents, burying stores and driving off the herds, and mounted raiders struck at the Tang supply line, using the distances of the plateau to slow the Tang advance; their best cavalry generally showered arrows on the Tang while its line was still forming and then pulled away, so as not to be caught by crossbow bolts and by the charge of the heavy horse. The settlement phase was carried through with commanderies and garrison farms: Xihai Commandery, Shanzhou and Guozhou were set up, officers appointed and households registered, so that the Tuyuhun tribes passed from a tribal organisation into the Tang system of jimi rule.
data: 兵力方面，記載最詳的《資治通鑑》記貞觀九年太宗西征發兵十餘萬、戰馬數萬匹，是唐初對外用兵規模的頂端數字，實際徵發當包含關中、隴右、關內諸道府兵、蕃兵與降部騎兵；李靖一路只率精騎五千，取的是奇兵而非全軍。戰果數字多出自戰報：侯君集在烏海一役破吐谷渾，記獲精騎以萬計、牛羊雜畜二十餘萬頭；李大亮於赤水源破其騎兵萬餘，追奔數百里；李道宗拔牛心堆城後追擊數百里，斬獲亦以數千計。行程方面，唐軍出長安取道隴右至靈州約二千餘里，再西行經鄯州、積石山入青海，戰線縱深亦達數千里，伏俟城在今青海共和一帶，距長安約三千餘里；自五月出師、六月在烏海與牛心堆交戰、至七月回師，前後約兩個月。季節約束極硬：青海夏季尚可取水，進磧之後水草俱無，戰馬與士卒掉隊多因飢渴與疲病，而非戰鬥本身。另一類數字關乎後勤的承載能力，唐軍需自涼州、鄯州轉運糧秣，數百里戈壁與峽谷道路使運輸成為制約，諸將屢以糧盡請還；吐谷渾方面的可用資源則是數十萬頭牛羊與可徵的馬群，這是它能長期擾邊、也讓唐軍在勝利之後仍須以郡縣屯田方式經營的原因。
dataEn: On numbers of troops, the fullest record, the Zizhi Tongjian, states that for the western campaign of 635 Taizong raised more than a hundred thousand men and several tens of thousands of horses, the largest figure for a Tang foreign expedition in the early dynasty; the actual levy must have drawn on the fubing of Guanzhong, Longyou and Guannei, on tribal soldiers and on the cavalry of surrendered groups, while Li Jing's column used only five thousand picked horsemen, a force chosen for surprise rather than for mass. Most of the results come from the battle reports: at Wuhai Hou Junji broke the Tuyuhun and took, it is recorded, some ten thousand of their picked cavalry and more than two hundred thousand head of cattle, sheep and other livestock; at Chishuiyuan Li Daliang defeated over ten thousand Tuyuhun horsemen and pursued them for several hundred li; after taking Niuxindui, Li Daozong pursued for several hundred li and the number of those killed and taken ran to thousands. As for distances, the Tang army left Chang'an by Longyou and reached Lingzhou in rather over two thousand li, then went west through Shanzhou and Mount Jishi into Qinghai, the depth of the front likewise running to several thousand li, while Fuhou city lies near today's Gonghe in Qinghai, about three thousand li from Chang'an; from the departure in the fifth month, through the fighting at Wuhai and Niuxindui in the sixth, to the return in the seventh, the whole business took about two months. The constraints of season were hard: in summer Qinghai could still supply water, but once the army entered the sand sea neither water nor fodder existed, and most of the losses of men and horses came from thirst, hunger and sickness rather than from battle. A second class of figures concerns what the logistics could bear. Tang had to move grain from Liangzhou and Shanzhou over hundreds of li of gravel desert and gorge road, which made transport the limiting factor and moved the generals to ask for withdrawal on the ground that supplies were spent; the resources on the Tuyuhun side were instead several hundred thousand head of cattle and sheep and a pool of horses that could be raised, which is why they could keep the border in turmoil for so long and why, even after the victory, Tang still had to hold the region by commandery and garrison farm.
cause: 直接起因是邊境寇掠與外交破裂。吐谷渾控有青海湖、柴達木盆地與河西走廊西段，扼住唐通往西域與吐蕃的孔道，其國以畜牧立國，戰馬與牛羊既是國力，也是它向唐廷索取年節貢賜、拒絕交出逃戶的依憑。慕容伏允在位時對唐的態度日趨強硬：拒詔使、隱匿人畜、掠取鄯州與涼州邊寨的官馬，把互市與朝貢當成可以隨手撕毀的籌碼。貞觀八年夏的寇涼州只是這種對抗的升級點，唐廷由此判定單靠交涉與羈縻已不足以降伏吐谷渾，遂遣兵討之。較深一層的動機是戰略地理：太宗志在打通青海道、斷絕吐谷渾作為唐與西域、蕃部間掣肘者的角色，並藉一場勝仗把青海納入唐的羈縻郡縣體系，以高原盟主的姿態換取經營西域的通道。吐谷渾內部也不是鐵板一塊，太子慕容順對伏允的剛愎自用頗有微詞，這為唐軍留下了招降與內應的空間；唐軍戰前的招撫與戰後的設郡，都是針對這一點設計的。
causeEn: The immediate cause was border raiding and a breakdown of diplomacy. Tuyuhun held Lake Qinghai, the Qaidam basin and the western end of the Hexi Corridor, and choked the roads by which Tang reached the Western Regions and Tibet. The state was founded on herding, and horses and cattle were both its national wealth and the basis on which it demanded annual tribute from the Tang court and refused to hand over those who had fled to it. Under Murong Fuyun the state's attitude towards Tang grew steadily harder: he refused edicts and envoys, concealed men and livestock, and raided the official horses of the frontier forts of Shanzhou and Liangzhou, treating the border markets and the missions of tribute as tokens he could discard at will. The raid on Liangzhou in the summer of 634 was only the point at which this antagonism escalated, and the court concluded that negotiation and jimi arrangements were no longer enough to bring Tuyuhun to heel, and so sent troops. A deeper motive was strategic geography: Taizong meant to open the Qinghai road, to end Tuyuhun's role as the counterweight between Tang and the peoples of the Western Regions and of Tibet, and to win a single victory that would bring Qinghai into the Tang system of jimi commanderies, buying the road by which the Western Regions would be governed. Nor was Tuyuhun solid internally: the heir Murong Shun had his reservations about Fuyun's obstinate self-will, and that left room for surrender and collusion inside the enemy camp; the attempts at inducement before the battle and the establishment of commanderies after it were both designed with that in mind.
impact: 此役最直接的後果，是一個獨立的青海政權被打散並嵌進唐的邊疆秩序。吐谷渾諸部以羈縻形式被重新編排：西海郡置於其舊地，鄯州、廓州管轄青海東南，太子慕容順出仕唐廷、任西海郡太守，部落首領多授以郡王、刺史之號，唐廷以羈縻而非直轄的方式維持對高原的影響。此後數十年，青海是唐在西北方向上少數穩定的騎兵與馬匹產地之一，也是唐經營西域、聯絡西域諸國的跳板；唐代邊塞詩文裡反覆出現的青海、積石、湝水，大體就是這條邊防線的產物。從長期看，內附並未換來永久安寧：吐谷渾與唐廷的關係在貞觀之後逐漸疏遠，七世紀六十年代吐蕃西進攻入青海，吐谷渾最後的汗被逐，餘眾或散入蕃地、或內附唐廷，唐朝其後在鄯州設都督府安置其眾，並以安西四鎮與隴右的部署接收這片草原與鹽澤。戰爭本身的代價同樣寫進史書：遠征數千里、糧秣自數百里外轉運、戰馬在磧中大量淘汰，唐廷在戰勝之後仍須以減省徭賦與加給軍資消化開支。
impactEn: The most direct consequence of this war was that an independent Qinghai polity was broken up and fitted into the Tang frontier order. The Tuyuhun tribes were rearranged in jimi form: Xihai Commandery was set up in their old country, Shanzhou and Guozhou took charge of the south-east of Qinghai, the heir Murong Shun entered Tang service as governor of Xihai, and tribal leaders were granted the titles of prince and prefect, so that Tang exercised influence over the plateau through jimi arrangements rather than direct administration. For the following several decades Qinghai was one of the few dependable sources of cavalry and horses in the north-west and the staging post from which Tang governed the Western Regions and kept in touch with its states; the Qinghai, Jishi and Huangshui that fill the frontier poems of the Tang are, in large measure, the product of this defensive line. In the long run the submission bought no lasting peace. Relations between Tuyuhun and the Tang court grew cooler after Zhenguan, and in the 660s Tibet advanced west into Qinghai, the last khan of Tuyuhun was driven out, and the survivors either scattered into Tibetan territory or submitted to Tang; the court afterwards set up a garrison headquarters at Shanzhou to settle them, and took over the grassland and salt marshes through the deployment of the four garrisons of Anxi and of Longyou. The cost of the war is recorded as well: an expedition of several thousand li, grain dragged forward from several hundred li away, and enormous numbers of horses worn out in the sand sea, with the Tang court obliged after the victory to absorb the expense through reduced labour service and additional military pay.
result: 唐軍在貞觀九年取得決定性的勝利，但這勝利是以連續兩年大規模出兵的代價換來。吐谷渾可汗慕容伏允在逃入磧中後被部下所殺，首級傳京師；唐軍沒有攻下幾座城寨，多數戰果來自對草場、馬群與移動部落的追擊，真正佔領的是道路與山口。慕容順率眾而降，被封為西平郡王，其後立西海郡，以順為西海郡太守，吐谷渾從獨立的汗國轉為唐的羈縻州縣，部眾由游牧編制改為編戶，首領仍保留一定世襲權力，這是唐對草原部族最常見的處理方式。軍事上，唐的邊界自河西走廊西端推向青海，控制了通往西域與吐蕃的孔道，河西走廊西段從此有了穩定後方。局限也記在同一份戰報裡：貞觀八年侯君集追擊至烏海即因糧道告急罷兵，遠征未能一次成功；李靖所部深入王都而未再擴張戰果，說明唐軍的補給上限仍遠低於其戰力上限。結果的另一面是吐谷渾並未就此消失，其政權在唐的庇蔭下延續了近三十年，直到七世紀中葉吐蕃西進才真正終結。
resultEn: The Tang army won a decisive victory in 635, but it was bought with two consecutive years of large-scale campaigning. The Tuyuhun khan Murong Fuyun was killed by his own subordinates after fleeing into the sand sea and his head was sent to the capital; the Tang army took few towns, for most of its results came from the pursuit of pastures, herds and moving tribes, and what it truly occupied were roads and passes. Murong Shun came in with his people, was made Prince of Xiping, and Xihai Commandery was then established with him as governor; Tuyuhun passed from an independent khanate to a jimi commandery of the Tang, its people from a nomadic organisation to registered households, while the leaders kept certain hereditary rights, which was the most common way Tang handled the tribal peoples of the steppe. Militarily the Tang frontier advanced from the western end of the Hexi Corridor into Qinghai, giving control of the corridor to the Western Regions and to Tibet, and the western stretch of the Hexi route acquired a secure rear. The limits appear in the same reports: in 634 Hou Junji halted at Wuhai when the supply line ran short, and the expedition was not carried through in one stroke; Li Jing's column reached the royal city but did not extend its operations further, which shows that the supply ceiling of the Tang army remained far below the ceiling of its fighting power. The other side of the result is that Tuyuhun did not thereby disappear: its polity survived for nearly thirty years under Tang protection and was only truly ended by the westward advance of Tibet in the middle of the seventh century.
